summary.en: BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual entry in Diffusion Model Application
summary.zh: BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）扩散模型应用年度条目

description.en:
BenchCouncil lists DreamBooth in the Diffusion Model Application area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “DreamBooth: Fine Tuning Text-to-Image Diffusion Models for Subject-Driven Generation”. The page names Nataniel Ruiz, Kfir Aberman as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
